title: A long-buried ancient library in Rome opens to the public after restoration

title: UN climate talks face overtime as countries clash over fossil fuel deal
description: The UN's Cop31 climate talks entered their endgame Friday, with countries sharply divided over a draft deal lacking any mention of planet-heating fossil fuels, threatening to push the negotiations into overtime.
